title: astragalus suffruticosus
intro: Astragalus suffruticosus, commonly known as dwarf milkvetch, is a perennial herb native to the mountainous regions of the Tibetan Plateau. It has been traditionally used in Tibetan medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving immune function, and enhancing physical endurance. The therapeutic actions of Astragalus suffruticosus are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit anti-inflammatory properties, and act as an adaptogen to help the body cope with stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
